label: D2 after a switch to a2 that commonly reached S2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the agent chose a2 and commonly reached S2 (in_action=2, in_state=2, common=1 on every activation), and only late in the episode (no activations before trial 50; rate rises steeply through trials 60-99). It is gated further toward low-value contexts: the model value at the step is below about 7.1 on nearly all activations, and it is enriched when the trial was a switch (stay=0, 7x lift), after an unrewarded previous trial, and when the choice was not the good one. Recorded predicate: D2 & S2 common & switch & ep_trial>=60 (dev P=0.69, R=0.42, F1=0.53, mass recall 0.50). Every variable in it is observed at D2. Dropping the switch condition in favour of low value gives recall 0.94 / mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.15, so the feature covers a2->S2-common D2 steps late in the episode with low value, and the switch condition picks out its strongest part. It also fires more weakly on stay trials that came after unrewarded a2 trials. Higher activations go with switch trials (top-quartile coverage 0.57 vs 0.34 bottom). It never fires at D1/GO, on S1, on rare transitions, or early in the episode.
